## Participations to conferences and community events

![](/images/logo/W4M_long_logo.jpg){height="1em"} members regularly attends conferences, it being about metabolomics or Galaxy. 
We also participates to various community events, it being on-site or on-line. 
We even sponsored GCC2024 in Brno, where people could come say Hi at our stand and grab a few free W4M goodies 😊

You can have an overview of some of our participations in the **Future and past events** section, in the *Talks and posters* tab.

## Trainings

![](/images/logo/W4M_long_logo.jpg){height="1em"} regularly propose trainings for the community. 
You can find regularly some W4M workshops at conferences, and we also provide online training materials (as for example some 
[![](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/assets/images/GTN-60px.png){height=1em} GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org/) training materials). 
To note, we also provide yearly bring-your-own data trainings, called ![](/images/logo/W4E_long_logo.jpg){height="1em"}.

### Workflow4Experimenters ![](/images/logo/W4E_short_logo.jpg){height="1em"}

Each year, the W4M team organizes a training school dedicated to the use of W4M infrastructure and analyze your own data (LC-MS, GC-MS and NMR data). 
This course (in English) is composed of an online theoretical part following by a one-week tutoring on-site session. 
During this practical part, you learn how to process your data with the help of tutors, from W4M and close partners, by applying the tools on you own data. 

For more information, contact us at workflow4metabolomics\@proton.me or visit the latest W4E event page below.

## Talks and posters

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(knitr)
library(magrittr)

# Read the CSV file
data <- read.table("ressources/W4M_Events_Talks.csv", sep = "," , header = TRUE)
## Parse authors
data$Authors <- sapply(data$Authors, function(x) {
  if (x != "" && is.character(x) && grepl(",", x)) {
    auth_vc <- strsplit(x, ",") %>% unlist() %>%  stringr::str_squish()
    if (length(auth_vc) > 2) {
      sprintf("%s et al.", auth_vc[1])
    } else {
      paste0(auth_vc, collapse = " and ")
    }
  } else {
    x
  }
})
## Parse links
data$Link <- sapply(data$Link, function(x) {
  if (grepl("^http.*", x)) {
    sprintf(
      '<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>',
      x,
      "Link"
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }
})

kable(
  data[order(-data$Year),],
  format = "html",
  escape = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
